raw: You know the terms upon which I have the honour and happiness to stand with the family.
If you please, committing you in no way, representing you in no way, I will undertake to correct my advice by the exercise of a little new observation and judgment expressly brought to bear upon it.
If you should then be dissatisfied with it, you can but test its soundness for yourself;
if, on the other hand, you should be satisfied with it, and it should be what it now is, it may spare all sides what is best spared.
“How long would you keep me in town?”
It is only a question of a few hours.
I could go to Soho in the evening, and come to your chambers afterwards.”
